summary.name: Raindance AI
summary.one_liner: A browser-based tool that turns two uploaded adult face photos into a roughly 15-second multi-shot pier/dock video sequence with ambient AI audio, sold as one-time credit packs.
use_cases: Make a short vertical pier or dock video for TikTok or Reels
Create a multi-shot trend-style clip from two photos
Produce a one-time paid AI video without a subscription
Preview photo framing before paying for a render
Experiment with AI-generated ambient audio for short clips
summary.what_it_does: The page describes a tool that takes two clear adult face photos and generates a ~15 second multi-shot pier/dock sequence (walk-on, mid, close-up, silhouette) in 9:16, 16:9 or 21:9 at 480p or 720p. Paid renders include ambient AI audio, which the page says is not a commercial song. Users can preview framing with their photos before paying. Pricing is per credit pack: a single 720p render costs $8.88, with 3-pack and Creator packs listed at $16.99 and $24.90, paid via Stripe with no account required. The page also shows silent demo clips and template pages for different looks, and states that it is an independent fan tool not affiliated with Dave, Tems, labels or the Raindance Film Festival.
notable: Multi-shot pier/dock sequence from only two photos, about 15 seconds
One-time credit packs via Stripe with no account or subscription
Preview framing with your photos before paying
caveats: Paid tiers only: single render from $8.88; credits are required to generate
Adults 18+ only, with authorized photos; no NSFW or non-consensual use
Does not host or license commercial songs; audio is ambient AI audio, not a commercial track
Render download links expire, so MP4s must be saved promptly
